== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|I've Got A Bad Feeling About This]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-ive-got-a-bad-feeling-about-this/ SWCCG Cards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_I_ve_Got_A_Bad_Feeling_About_This.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>53e5a851be8a2611a40ae47ed2581a72a8884233f1fbdc654c9ea575cb23810f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
